creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster window --watch` and `muster pane wait` print nothing when a daemon stops answering. A wait on a devenv pane over a dropped VPN therefore sits silent until its `--timeout`, then exits 5 as though the agent had simply not finished.

The watch hears agent-state changes and closed panes, and nothing about daemon health (added in `31d7e9e`). `docs/cli/limits.md` says so. The likely fix is a line per daemon health change on the watch, and a wait that ends early (with its own exit) when a daemon it depends on goes stale.

Found by slot 3 of the 2026-09-12 round while building the watch.
title: A watch or a wait hears nothing when a daemon goes stale
